title:
China is now investigating DeepSeek and Moonshot after Anthropic accused them of secretly forwarding some requests to Claude.

Anthropic says Moonshot routed over 23 million exchanges to Claude between May and July, and DeepSeek routed over 12 million in 14 days. investigation is ongoing, and nothing is proven yet. China’s concern is if sensitive domestic police and military-related data was sent to a US company without the users knowing.
